value.title: View from the Window at Le Gras
value.snippet: (French: Point de vue du Gras) is the oldest surviving photograph. It was created by French inventor Nicéphore Niépce in 1826 in Saint-Loup-de-Varennes, France

value.title: Heliography
value.snippet: the hardening of bitumen in sunlight. It was invented by Nicéphore Niépce around 1822. Niépce used the process to make the earliest known surviving photograph
